# Senior Frontend Engineer (React)

**Company:** Lumen Harbor
**Location:** Remote (United States)
**Team:** Web Experience
**Employment type:** Full-time

## About Lumen Harbor

Lumen Harbor makes scheduling and booking software used by independent studios and clinics. Our web
application is used daily by hundreds of thousands of people, and we care about a fast, accessible and
consistent interface.

## The role

You will be a senior member of the Web Experience team, responsible for the quality of our customer-facing
React application. You will shape our design system, raise the bar on accessibility and performance, and
work side by side with designers and product managers.

## What you will do

- Build and maintain features in a large React and TypeScript codebase.
- Contribute to and evolve our design system, including component APIs, documentation and tokens.
- Ensure every new interface meets WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards.
- Write unit and integration tests with Jest and end-to-end tests with Playwright.
- Profile and improve runtime performance, bundle size and Core Web Vitals.
- Review pull requests and mentor less experienced frontend engineers.
- Collaborate with designers to turn prototypes into polished, responsive interfaces.
- Partner with backend engineers on API design and data-fetching patterns.

## Must-have qualifications

- 6+ years of professional frontend development experience.
- Expert-level React, including hooks, context and rendering behaviour.
- Strong TypeScript skills in a production codebase.
- Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library.
- Practical knowledge of accessibility (WCAG), screen readers and keyboard navigation.
- Experience testing with Jest and Playwright, or comparable tools.
- A track record of measurable web performance improvements.

## Nice-to-have qualifications

- Experience with Next.js or another React framework.
- Familiarity with Storybook and visual regression testing.
- Experience with GraphQL clients.
- Interest in animation and interaction design.

## What success looks like

- In three months you have shipped a meaningful feature and joined the design system working group.
- In six months you lead accessibility audits for a major product area.
- In twelve months you own the performance budget for the web application.

## Compensation and benefits

- Base salary range: USD 160,000 to 200,000.
- Equity, health coverage, a home-office stipend and a yearly learning budget.

## Hiring process

1. A recruiter conversation.
2. A frontend pairing session on a small React task.
3. A conversation about accessibility and performance trade-offs.
4. A team conversation covering collaboration and mentoring.

Lumen Harbor is an equal opportunity employer.
